cohort: 73 cases of postpartum maternal deaths from 2009-2012 and 9,221 postpartum women from the Birth in Brazil Study
finding: After controlling for indication bias and confounders, cesarean delivery was independently associated with a nearly three-fold increased risk of postpartum maternal death compared to vaginal delivery, primarily due to deaths from postpartum hemorrhage and complications of anesthesia.
